title: Ask What Your Country Can Do For You: Towards a Public Red Teaming Model

bias_targets.methodology: A multilingual and multicultural public red teaming exercise (IMDA Singapore AI Safety Red Teaming Challenge) where participants evaluated LLMs for context-specific harms across different cultures in the Asia-Pacific region.
A public red teaming challenge evaluating LLM outputs for context-specific harms across nine different countries and languages.
